content:
[Intro (Fade In)]
[C/F]

[Verse 1]
[C/F]We had a
great day
Even though we forgot
[C]to eat
And you had
[C/F]a bad dream
Then we got
[C]no sleep
'Cause we were
[C/F]kissing

[Verse 2]
[C/F]I had a
fever
Until I
[C]met you
Now you make
[C/F]me cool
But sometimes I
[C]still do
Something em-
[C/F]barrassing
I never said

[Chorus]
[C]I'd be all [G]right
[F]Just thought I could hold
[C]myself [G]together
[F]But I couldn't breathe,
[C]I went [G]outside
[F]Don't know why I
[C]thought it'd be [G]any better
[F]I'm fine now, it
[C]doesn't [G]matter
[F]I didn't wan-
[C]na be this [G]guy
[F]I cried at your show
[C]with the [G]teenagers
[F]Tell your friend I'll
[C]be all [G]right
[F]In the mor-
[C]ning it won't [G]matter
[F]I wanna be ema-
[G][C]ciated
[F]I wanna hear one
[C]song without thinking [G]of you
[F]I wish I was
[C]on a [G]spaceship
[F]Just me and my dog
[C]and an [G]impossible view
[F]
I

[Interlude]
[C]dream a-
[Em]bout
[F]it
And I
[C]wake up
[Em]falling
[F]

[Outro]
[F]
title: Me and my dog
tuning: E A D G B E
